enablePrelaunchSplash.name: Enable Prelaunch Splash
enablePrelaunchSplash.description: Whether to show prelaunch splash for this app
enablePrelaunchSplash.description[zh_CN]: 是否为此应用显示预启动闪屏

prelaunchSplashMismatchCount.name: Prelaunch Splash Mismatch Count
prelaunchSplashMismatchCount.name[zh_CN]: 预启动闪屏不匹配次数
prelaunchSplashMismatchCount.description: Consecutive splash match failure count for this app, persisted across restarts; reset to 0 on a successful match, and also reset to 0 when the count reaches the threshold and splash is auto-disabled. 0 means no failure recorded.
prelaunchSplashMismatchCount.description[zh_CN]: 该应用连续闪屏匹配失败次数，持久化保存（重启后保留）；匹配成功时重置为0，达到阈值自动禁用闪屏时同样重置为0。0 表示无失败记录。
